import (
	"fmt"
)

resp, err := client.Products().UpdateProduct(ctx, 101, map[string]any{
	"name":                    "Cotton T-Shirt",
	"sku":                     "TSHIRT-001",
	"base_price":              25.0,
	"product_type":            "physical",
	"available":               true,
	"is_on_sale":              false,
	"available_on_date_range": false,
	"available_on_weekdays":   map[string]any{"enabled": false, "weekdays": []any{}},
	"available_for":           "all",
	"selected_customers":      map[string]any{"customers": []any{}, "groups": []any{}},
	"invoice_note":            "Ships in 2 business days",
	"advanced":                map[string]any{"advance_information": map[string]any{"mpn": "MPN-0001"}},
}, nil)
if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}
product := resp.Map().(map[string]any)["product"].(map[string]any)
information := product["advanced"].(map[string]any)["advance_information"].(map[string]any)
fmt.Println(product["invoice_note"], information["mpn"], product["version"])
